net.mirrors_sub: Tried in order when GitHub can't be reached. The manifest is ed25519-signed and every package is sha256-checked, so a mirror can't alter anything; at worst the download fails.
net.presets_note: Third-party GitHub proxies, off by default; they see your IP and what you download and may disappear.
net.e.timeout: Timed out: GitHub can't be reached.
net.e.signature: Update manifest signature is invalid; rejected.
net.e.checksum: Downloaded file failed its checksum; discarded.
net.h.timeout: You probably need a proxy. In Settings → Network pick Auto / system (reads your OS proxy) or enter one manually, then Test. You can also add a download mirror.
net.h.dns: Check your connection; if you use a proxy, set it in Settings → Network.
net.h.tls: A corporate network or proxy may be intercepting HTTPS. Try another network or set a proxy in Settings → Network.
net.h.proxy: The proxy address is wrong or the proxy app isn't running. Check host and port in Settings → Network.
net.h.refused: A network or firewall blocked it. Try a proxy or a mirror.
net.h.http_404: The mirror may not have this version yet. Try later or download manually.
net.h.http: Try again later; if it keeps failing, download manually.
net.h.signature: Nothing unsigned gets installed. The mirror or network may be tampering; switch route or download manually.

sr.title: Skill repositories
sr.subtitle: Add Git repositories and install the skills you need.
sr.remove_hint: Remove the source and cache for “{name}”? Installed skills and version history will remain.
sr.empty_hint: Use HTTPS or SSH clone URLs from GitHub, GitLab, Gitee, or your own Git server.
sr.transport_hint: Uses Git, credential helpers, and SSH configuration on the machine running Tidebot.
sr.url_hint: Use HTTPS or SSH. Do not include passwords or tokens in the URL.
sr.root_hint: Leave empty for the whole repository, or enter a path such as skills.
sr.auth_hint: Private repositories use configured Git credentials or SSH agent on the server. Scanning reports missing Git, credentials, or host trust.
sr.edit_hint: Changing the URL, ref, or scan directory requires a new scan. Existing installations and history remain.
sr.source_removed: Source removed; the local skill remains available.
sr.local_modified: The local version differs from the last adopted upstream version. Downloading preserves local changes; adopting switches the current version.
sr.pending_hint: A downloaded version is waiting to be adopted.
sr.apply_hint: Tasks following the current version will use the new version on their next run. Pinned versions, frozen compositions, and active runs stay unchanged. You can roll back from version history.
sr.scan_failed: The last scan failed. Showing the last successful catalog.
sr.cancelled: Scan cancelled; the previous catalog is retained.
sr.scan_hint: The first scan may fetch the current repository snapshot, but only selected skill directories are installed. A successful scan does not verify runtime dependencies.
sr.scan_first: Select “Scan / check updates” to discover skills.
sr.install_hint: Only files in the selected skill directories are imported. Scripts are not run, dependencies are not installed, and plugin MCP is not enabled. Imports do not preserve script executable permissions; verify skills that execute scripts directly.
sr.copy: Save as an independent skill copy
sr.download_hint: An existing skill downloads a pending version without changing its current version. Local renaming does not change the internal command name; conflicting command names in a composition remain rejected.
sr.clear_cache_hint: Delete this repository’s download cache? Installed skills remain. Scan again before previewing or installing.

wfe.repo_scan_limit: Repository scan limit exceeded. Narrow the scan directory.

wfe.repo_unsafe_path: The skill contains an unsafe file path and cannot be installed.
wfe.repo_path_collision: Skill file paths collide and cannot be installed safely.
wfe.repo_lfs_unsupported: The skill contains Git LFS pointers. Automatic LFS downloads are not supported.
wfe.repo_invalid_frontmatter: Invalid SKILL.md metadata. Check the upstream file.
wfe.repo_snapshot_missing: Repository snapshot is unavailable. Scan and preview again.
wfe.repo_skill_missing: The selected skill is no longer present. Scan again.
wfe.repo_git_failed: Git operation failed. Check repository connectivity and Git configuration on the server.
wfe.repo_conflict: Repository configuration, skill version, or preview has changed. Refresh and preview again.
wfe.repo_name_conflict: A local skill already uses this name. Use the suggested name or enter another.
wfe.repo_not_found: This repository no longer exists. Refresh the list.
wfe.repo_timeout: Repository operation timed out. Check connectivity and retry.
wfe.repository_error: Repository operation failed. Check the entered information and scan again.
sr.warning_external_resources: This skill may reference resources outside its directory. Only this directory is installed; check dependencies before running.
sr.warning_nested_skills: This directory contains nested skills. Installation preserves all child files without registering child skills separately.
wfe.repo_invalid_id: Invalid repository identifier. Refresh the repository list.
wfe.repo_path_not_found: Scan directory not found. Check the path inside the repository.
sr.usage_follow: Follows current · adopts on next run
sr.usage_pinned: Pinned version · unaffected by this update

fp.intro: No token to obtain or API key to enter. Uses Kilo’s official anonymous free access; availability, quotas and rate limits are set by Kilo.
fp.privacy: Task prompts, file contents and tool results are sent to Kilo and the model provider. Free models may use this content for training. Do not send sensitive data to this provider.
fp.consent: I understand and agree that the selected free model may use submitted content for training.
fp.models_hint: kilo-auto/free selects among free models. Only verified zero-priced models supporting tool calling are listed, with no paid fallback.
fp.load: Save consent and refresh free models
fp.no_models: No eligible free models are available. Try refreshing later.
fp.model_info: {n} free models · Context {context} · Max output {output} tokens
fp.ready: Plugin ready. Requests remain subject to upstream availability and rate limits.
fp.inactive: Save the configuration and enable the plugin to use it.
fp.use_hint: After saving, select kilo-free as the task provider. Your default provider stays unchanged. Disabling the plugin, revoking network access or withdrawing consent stops free pool requests.
fp.docs: Kilo model and data usage documentation
fp.free_only: Free models only, recorded at zero cost
fp.managed_hint: Configure models and consent in the Kilo free model pool plugin. You can test the connection or explicitly make it your default provider here.
fp.need_install: Install and approve the plugin from the official catalog first.
fp.need_enable: The plugin is disabled. Enable it on the plugin card.
fp.need_network: Approve network access to ai-gateway.kilo.ai on the plugin card.
fp.need_consent: Read and accept the data usage notice above, then save to enable the free pool.

costmode.title: Task cost control
costmode.retained: Amounts are retained while disabled. Costs are always recorded.
costmode.global_hint: Only the shared daily money budget applies.
costmode.bypass_hint: Bypass task limits and the shared daily money budget.
costmode.warning: Costs may continue to accrue and exceed global budgets, affecting other tasks. All usage is recorded. Provider quotas, timeouts, permissions and explicit invocation safety caps still apply.
costmode.next_start: Applies at the next actual launch. Active runs retain their launch-time policy.
costmode.historical: No cost policy was recorded for this historical run
costmode.spend_notice: Bypassed tasks remain in total spending. Global budgets do not cap their spending.
costmode.paused: This task is paused. Changing cost controls does not resume it. Enable the task above if you also want it to resume.
costmode.task_hint: Enforces the shared daily money budget and task run, daily and token limits.
cap.confirm_note: Installs only into tidebot and binds to this session from the next turn. No CLI dependencies are installed and system configuration is unchanged.
cap.reviewed: I have inspected the files and understand the source risks
cap.risk_confirm: I confirm I accept the additional risks above
cap.blocked: Installation is blocked by source risk
cap.installed: Capability installed and bound to the session
cap.untrusted: This is untrusted upstream content. Its instructions are not executed here.
cap.load_error: Confirmation cards could not load. Refresh to retry.
cap.search: Search capabilities, e.g. DingTalk or PDF
cap.subtitle: Discover, review and manage capabilities available only to bound runs.
cap.no_installed: No capabilities installed. Choose one in Discover.
cap.bindings_note: Choose tasks, workflow nodes or buttons that may use this capability. Changes apply to future runs. Manage session bindings in the session.
cap.download_deps: Also download and install the pinned dependencies listed above into tidebot data
cap.rollback_note: Future follow-bound runs will use the selected version. Pinned bindings stay unchanged.
cap.import_size: Choose a capability JSON file no larger than 90 MB.
cap.uninstall_note: Unbind this capability first. Exclusive unchanged skill registrations are removed; shared, edited or referenced skills are kept. Immutable snapshots, historical versions, tools and credentials are retained for reviewed cleanup.
cap.confirm_download_note: Installs only into tidebot data. Dependencies are installed only when you select the download option. Existing system tools are not changed.
cap.oauth_note: Review the service domain and scopes, then authorize on the provider website. Tokens stay in the secret store.
cap.register_client: Allow registering a tidebot OAuth client with this service (creates persistent connection configuration)
cap.auth_return: Return here after completion. Do not paste authorization codes or tokens into chat.
cap.optimize_proposal_note: This only creates a proposal, without starting a model. The card shows the analysis cost cap.
cap.optimize_cost: Analysis costs up to US$0.10. It creates an improvement proposal without adopting it.
cap.analysis_ready: Analysis complete. Review the improvement proposal.
cap.credentials_note: Only declared credentials can be saved. Values go to the secret store, are never shown again, and do not enter chat. Leave blank to keep the existing value.
cap.external_warning: Local files remain read-only, but external tools may change service data. Review each tool description; a service’s “read-only” claim is not a safety guarantee. Access applies only to this conversation and version.
cap.grant_empty: Run the free self-test for a bound MCP capability in Extensions, then return to select tools.
cap.cli_login_note: Runs the official dws auth login --device flow. dws keeps the login tokens; administrator consent may be needed. Closing this dialog does not cancel login; use Cancel login to stop it.
cap.login_failed_note: Device login failed, expired, or was cancelled. Check organization authorization and retry.
cap.login_completed_note: DingTalk reported a successful login; credentials remain managed by dws.
cap.clear_credentials_note: Revoke remote OAuth access, then delete this capability’s saved credentials. Other capabilities are unaffected. If a provider cannot revoke access, its local token is retained and an error is shown. Clear credentials before uninstalling if you do not want to keep them.
cap.quota_warning: A storage limit has been reached. No data is deleted automatically.
cap.gc_note: Remove only tidebot-owned, unreferenced managed versions and cache unused for at least 30 days. Keep one unused version for rollback. Installed/history references and system tools are preserved.
cap.clean_snapshots_note: Remove only unused old snapshots. Keep the current version, one rollback version, explicit version pins and historical run references. Shared tools can then be cleaned from Tools and runtimes.
cap.auto_test_ready: Installed. Free dependency and MCP discovery checks passed.
cap.auto_test_attention: Installed. Some checks need attention. Open Extensions → Test to review dependencies or connect the account.
cap.default_new: Bind to new sessions by default
cap.default_note: New sessions receive this capability. External MCP tools still require separate exact-tool approval.
cap.deactivate_note: Remove all current bindings, session grants and the new-session default. Keep installed files and historical run records. Active bound runs must finish first.
cap.smoke_prompt: Read the bound capability documentation and describe one safe read-only example. Do not modify local or external data, install anything, or request credentials in chat.
cap.smoke_note: Review the prompt and session budget, then press Send to start a paid model turn.
cap.uninstall_review: Remove the capability registration and tool grants. Remove only exclusive, unreferenced skill registrations listed below. Keep snapshots, dependencies, environments and credentials; remote OAuth is not revoked.
cap.local_choices_note: Choose how to handle each edited skill. No local changes are replaced without your choice.
cap.copy: Keep a separate local copy and adopt upstream
cap.adopt_upstream: Adopt upstream; retain local version in history
cap.public_search: Also search skills.sh and GitHub (sends this search query)
cap.legacy_note: Native plugins retain their existing individual permissions. Manage them separately; capability imports never activate native runtime components.
cap.sources_note: Save a marketplace or the official MCP Registry. Refresh marketplaces explicitly to include their entries in searches. Membership does not confer trust.
cap.remove_source_note: Remove this saved discovery source. Installed capabilities are retained.
cap.preferences_note: Set an absolute executable path or prefer managed tools for future reviews. Existing installations need a new rescan review. This does not authorize downloads.
set.bud_scope: One shared daily money budget covers sessions, tasks, assistance, optimization and canary runs. Set individual task limits in each task. Explicitly bypassed tasks remain exempt.
tf.timeout_hint: 1–1440 minutes per run, starting when a run slot is acquired. Queue time is excluded. A timeout stops only that run. Leave the limit off for unlimited execution.
cap.grant_purpose: Choose which external service tools AI may use in this conversation, such as looking up information or working with connected services. Ordinary chat needs no authorization.
cap.grant_select: Select only the tools you need, then save access. Change or revoke access while the conversation is idle.
cap.grant_no_description: No description provided by the service. Verify its purpose before granting access.
cap.grant_optional: You can close this dialog to chat or read local files. To use external tools:
cap.grant_step_bind: Bind the MCP extension you need using this conversation’s capabilities control.
cap.grant_step_test: Open Extensions and run the capability’s free self-test to discover its tools.
cap.grant_step_select: Return to this conversation to select and authorize individual tools.
rc.long_tip: With many turns, each turn carries more context and costs more. You can keep going or start a new session.
wf.timeout_tip: No time limit by default. When on, the whole workflow stops after this long; finished steps keep their results.
sp.unl_text: Removed the default $0.05 per-run cap from {n} tasks. They now follow only the global daily budget (none set = unlimited).
sp.unl_restored: Restored the per-run cap on {n} tasks
sp.unl_fail: That didn’t work, please try again
rd.acc_tip: After this command run, tidebot compared before and after and found these agent config files changed (~/.claude, a project’s .claude/, .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md …).
rd.acc_note: tidebot didn’t undo these changes (putting them back would itself change your config). Please check them yourself.
pl.sb_ok_tip: Command runs go into the system sandbox: they can write only the working and temp folders, can’t read key folders, and have no network by default.
pl.sb_missing_tip: Missing {m}. Open for how to install; until then command runs are refused.
pl.sb_none_tip: Windows has no system sandbox: command runs are protected only by permission rules and the after-run config check.
